description.p: You are given two strings s and t. Determine whether the string s can be obtained by deleting some (possibly none) characters from the string t without changing the order of the remaining characters.

description.pre:
Input: s = "abc", t = "a1b2c3"
Output: True
Explanation: You can delete the digits from t to get t = "abc"

ul: The strings s and t contain only ascii characters
Time: O(m), where m is the length of t

solution.note: A common mistake: thinking the time complexity is O(n+m) or O(min(n, m)). But it is the length of the string t that limits the maximum number of iterations in the worst case.
